Wigggle Widgets b4

Wigggle widgets · batch b4

Six wigggle-ui widgets, each the real React component from the registry, styled by Tailwind compiled from its own class names. Top of each card: the demo site in dark mode today. Below: the staged .dc.html running live. Calendar dates are today's, as the source renders them. To approve, put approved on the first line of plans/component-build-approval-b4.txt, then any slug: note lines.

Calendar SM 06

Small calendar: today's date, three events with coloured rails and join buttons.

slug calendar-sm-06registry wigggle-ui.vercel.app/r/calendar-sm-06.jsonsections idle
